name: argo-database-manager
description: For the ARGO database manager. Start with the weekly check: where every study stands and what's waiting for you (weekly-check). Then fulfil it: build a study's REDCap from a submitted request (build-study), get data out as files (export-data), and match records across studies with safe fill-blanks-only write-back (link-data). Works with or without an access key.
